command_line:
{
set +e
printf '%s\n' '--- root ---'
ls -la /
printf '%s\n' '--- possible ref dirs ---'
for d in /reference /ref /data /datasets /hg38 /opt /software /cvmfs; do echo DIR=$d; ls -la "$d" 2>&1 | head -40; done
printf '%s\n' '--- find fasta/index ---'
find / -maxdepth 4 \( -iname '*.fa' -o -iname '*.fasta' -o -iname '*.bt2' -o -iname '*.tar' -o -iname '*.tar.gz' -o -iname '*.2bit' -o -iname '*hg38*' -o -iname '*GRCh38*' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -400
printf '%s\n' '--- df ---'
df -h . /tmp /workspace 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- singularity/apptainer ---'
command -v apptainer || true
command -v singularity || true
command -v wget || true
command -v curl || true
command -v gsutil || true
command -v aws || true
exit 0
} > probe.txt 2>&1
